title: SG-7 Story Panel and Round status UI with real API integration
summary: Story Panel shows scene title, dialogue, choices, history and inventory; header round status uses the real Go API with loading, empty and error states and a retry
description: Context: StoryPanel lacks the scene title, independent scroll and pixel-art styling. HeaderOverlay shows a bare 'Round unavailable: <msg>' with no retry. Desired behavior: a complete Story Panel and an explained, retryable round status header, both wired to existing state and the existing getCurrentRound client. Expected result: unit tests with the API mocked cover panel rendering, choice clicks and the round loading, success, empty and error states. Why: players need readable story context and a recoverable round status.
acceptance_criteria: Given game state, when StoryPanel renders, then it shows the scene title, dialogue, choices, history and inventory
Given the Round API fails, when the header renders, then it explains the cause and offers a Retry button
Given Retry is clicked and the API succeeds, when the request resolves, then the header shows round id, status and countdown
Given no round exists (404), when the header renders, then it shows the distinct empty state, not an error

preserve: No mock data in production code

definition_of_done: All requirements verified by unit tests with the API mocked
non_functional: Story panel scrolls independently without page scroll
